beats.place: Wet cobblestone service alley at dawn, waist-high crate stack in the foreground, stainless back door in the background
beats.camera: Over-the-shoulder third-person camera behind Rena at shoulder height, holding still with a slight breathing bob
beats.action: Rena stays low behind the crate stack with the tote on her shoulder while Oka stands at the back door and looks at his wristwatch; nobody else is in frame
beats.sfx: Distant kitchen extractor, a bottle crate ticking as it settles, quiet alley drip
beats.music: Low pulsing synth bass with a single taiko hit at the start; holds under the whole clip

beats.place: The same wet service alley, camera facing the open stainless back door, morning steam from a roof vent
beats.camera: Third-person camera behind and slightly above Rena, tracking forward smoothly at walking pace
beats.action: Rena walks at a calm pace down the alley toward the open back door, tote on her shoulder, keeping to the wall; the door stays open and empty
beats.sfx: Kitchen sneakers on wet stone, extractor hum, a distant dish clink
beats.music: Low pulsing synth bass, a little faster; a rhythmic hi-hat joins

beats.place: Inside a small stainless izakaya kitchen: prep table, rice cooker, hanging ladles, one round wall clock with no numerals readable, the whole room stays the kitchen
beats.camera: Static medium two-shot at eye level, a very slow push-in
beats.action: Rena takes the folded paper slip from the tote and hands it to Oka across the prep table; he takes it with both hands and nods; both stay standing in the same spot

speech.line: でんぴょう、とどけました
おお、たすかる。カードも たのむよ
speech.text: おお、助かる。タイムカードも頼むよ

beats.sfx: Quiet kitchen, a fridge motor, paper rustle
beats.music: Soft warm pad, the bass rests

beats.place: The same kitchen, beside a wall-mounted analogue time-clock box with a slot, morning light from a high window
beats.camera: Third-person camera over Rena's right shoulder at the time-clock, holding still
beats.action: Rena slides the paper time card into the wall slot with two fingers and leaves it there; she stands still; the clock box stays on the same wall
beats.sfx: Soft paper scrape in a metal slot, fridge motor, a kettle click
beats.music: Bass returns with a slow taiko pattern
